title: CP: 12 November cutover checklist with owners and go/stop gates
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/CUTOVER-DAY-CHECKLIST.md for Thursday 12 November 2026. Twenty-five ordered rows each name Rhys, John or Code, the action, evidence, GO condition and STOP condition. Release order is 138, 140, 141, 144, 145, 146 with exact release/verify paths. Existing verified releases are not blindly reinstalled.

Carries the actual GO-LIVE-DATA-LOAD.md process: frozen real exports and complete backup/restore, exact combined private-kit/archive preservation, real importer dry run, separate actual-load authority, exact-pence reconciliation, accountant WIP, numbering and protected Marpet/login/settings/audit comparisons. The fake no-write wrapper is explicitly not an importer. All steps rehearse on disposable copies first; synthetic suites never target live data.

After any 146 rollback: STOP, do not reapply it on that database; retain history/usage/key_source and existing refusal guards. No invented import/SQL command, extra migration or scope added. Final gate is independent review only; Rhys and reviewer still make their own decisions.

Checks: all 25 ordered owner/result rows, six release file paths/order, calendar date, data-load and rollback stop rules verified against source d7d6ff9dbd915becdc096d1eb365e4a73b4ae21d. Documentation only, no SQL/data load/wipe/main merge/Ready label executed. Sibling CN/CO guides must be included in the reviewed pack before following those references.

- [x] Ordered owner checklist, apply order, SliQ load and stop gates
- [ ] Independent review, actual rehearsal and separate operational decisions
